content.comment_body: Excuse me, I received an email about a supposed firmware update for [product_name] [version_no] and [version_no]. I have already updated [product_name] [product_name] and have the firmware file, but I need to copy it to the root folder of the [product_name] memory device. Does anyone know which folder this is or how to create it? Here is the link: [url]

Closed because this question was posted twice. The second thread with the subject '[product_name] firmware update - Have to copy it to the root folder of the [product_name] memory device, how does it work?' is published within the [product_name] conference. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unsure about how to complete a firmware update for [product_name] hardware modules, especially regarding copying the firmware file to the correct location on the memory storage device. The main issue is the absence of detailed, step-by-step instructions on how to find or create the appropriate folder structure on the device, which creates confusion in the update process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clearly explained steps and guidance on where and how to place the firmware file on the memory storage device in order to properly update [product_name] hardware modules.
